description: A lounge above the concourse with a long bar down one side and windows over the field down the other. The carpet is patterned with baseballs and worn through to the backing in a path from the stairs to the bar. A door east has PLATINUM on it in silver.

window.description: Tall windows over the first-base line, filmed with old smoke. The field is green below them, and the lamps along the roof's rails hang level with the glass.
window.name: the club windows

name: The Coliseum — Club Level
